The reviewer receives the original delegated task and the delegate\'s final context, returns a 0–100 Reviewer Score, and can correct unsupported or contradictory details. It cannot be the delegate, primary model, or another profile using the same model.
Memory is sampled after each test for this Android app, including remote runs; it is not server memory or a continuous peak. Thermal and battery readings are context, not efficiency scores.

A fixed benchmark preset evaluates evidence, tools, research, handoff and robustness. Full repeats all eight pipeline checks. Research uses controlled source fixtures. Conversation settings are unchanged.

%1$s target output tokens per helper call · %2$s concurrent workers. Expand to customize limits.

Quick: exactly 5 tests, one per category, including 6 Intelligence questions in one compact test. Full: exactly 50 tests — 18 timing (3 warm-ups), 8 task accuracy, 6 JSON, 12 tool contracts and 6 Intelligence tests covering 36 questions. Tools use a harmless fixture. Unsupported tools are recorded, not failed. A test may include tool round trips or a transport retry. Each test has a 90-second limit. Only Full can establish repeated timing ratings.

Quality, reliability, speed, first response and consistency use the same timing policy here and in Compare. The Scoreboard uses absolute capability accuracy. Overall needs every dimension; missing timing is never invented. Quick and Full both include tool fixtures. Quick remains provisional. Local context tiers and remote cohorts are ranked separately.
